parameters.query:
WITH woche AS (
    SELECT * FROM anrufe
    WHERE beginn >= now() - interval '7 days'
)
SELECT
    to_char(now() - interval '7 days', 'DD.MM.') AS von,
    to_char(now(), 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS bis,
    count(*) AS anrufe,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE kanal = 'sip_trunk') AS telefon,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE erfolgreich = 'success') AS erfolgreich,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE erfolgreich IS DISTINCT FROM 'success') AS auffaellig,
    coalesce(round(avg(dauer_sek)), 0) AS dauer_schnitt_sek,
    coalesce(round(sum(kosten_usd), 2), 0) AS kosten_usd,
    coalesce(
        string_agg(
            to_char(beginn AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI')
            || '  ' || coalesce(erfolgreich, 'unknown')
            || '  ' || coalesce(titel, 'ohne Titel')
            || ' (' || dauer_sek || ' s, ' || kanal || ')'
            || E'\n    ' || anruf_id,
            E'\n\n' ORDER BY beginn
        ) FILTER (WHERE erfolgreich IS DISTINCT FROM 'success'),
        'Keine.'
    ) AS liste
FROM woche;
